title: Average of Three Numbers
description: Read three numbers and print their average formatted to 2 decimal places.
instructions: Read three numbers (integers or decimals) from stdin.
Print the result formatted to 2 decimal places.
hints: Wrap `a + b + c` in parentheses before dividing by `3.0`.

starterCode.python:
import sys
a, b, c = map(float, sys.stdin.read().split()[:3])
